generate.description: Generate the architecture dependency graph and save it

visualize.description: View saved architecture without refreshing; refresh: pnpm nx run architecture:generate

visualize-runtime.description: View saved runtime architecture without refreshing; refresh: pnpm nx run architecture:generate

validate-runtime-architecture.description: Validate the runtime microservice graph: no disallowed cycles, unchanged vs committed

validate-no-architecture-cycles.description: Validate the architecture graph has no circular project dependencies

validate-architecture-unchanged.description: Validate the architecture graph matches the saved blessed graph

validate-api-relations.description: Validate every server/client api-lib dependency is implemented or used (no unexplained edges)

validate-api-lib-tag.description: Validate role:api-lib matches the code (exports an @ApiPath/@Rpc/@PubSub contract), both directions

validate-no-file-import-cycles.description: Check a project for circular file imports with madge (config-driven on/off + grace window)

validate-packagejson.description: Validate package.json dependencies match project.json build dependencies

validate-ts-in-src.description: Validate all .ts files in projects are inside the src/ directory

validate-checklist-docs.description: Validate the pr-gate checklists[] block: docs exist, patterns compile, ids unique, blockMessage on BLOCK

validate-rules-config.description: Validate webpieces.config.json once at the scoped rules:check boundary

validate-code.description: Execute declared build contributions through their public owner runtimes, with optional single-rule debug execution

help.description: Display help for @webpieces/nx-webpieces-rules commands and targets

validate-versions-locked.description: Validate package.json versions are locked (no semver ranges) and npm ci compatible

validate-eslint-sync.description: Validate that workspace and template eslint.webpieces.config.mjs files have identical rules

di-graph-generate.description: Per-project: generate the Inversify DI dependency DAG into design.json + design.md at the project root

openapi-generate.description: Per-project, inferred from the generate:openapi tag: render the contracts to OpenAPI + one mcp-<ContractClass>-tools.json per MCP contract into the build (tsc) target outputPath, with the consumer's own @webpieces/openapi-generator

openapi-components-generate.description: Inferred on generate:openapi-components: write a DTO library's components.openapi.json into its build outputPath

docs-generate.description: Per-project, inferred from the generate:docs-site tag: render the static API reference site from a generated document into <projectRoot>/<siteDir>, with the consumer's own @webpieces/docs-site

validate-nx-wiring.description: Validate the webpieces validators are wired into the build via nx.json targetDefaults dependsOn
